description: Capture and persist stderr alongside stdout in plan-preflight failure detail so halting preflight failures are diagnosable.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirms Bun.spawnSync returns a SyncSubprocess whose stdout and stderr are `Buffer | undefined` (not ReadableStream as in async Bun.spawn), so the existing `r.stdout instanceof Buffer ? new TextDecoder().decode(...) : ''` guard is the correct shape to mirror for r.stderr. No deprecation or breaking change affects this call site; stderr: 'pipe' is already passed at sidecar.ts:2640 and populates r.stderr.

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: WARNING [test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:249]: AC7's stderr-first ordering invariant has no regression assertion. The two 'BOTH streams' tests (:249-250 typecheck, :303-304 bun-test) assert only detail.toContain(...) for each stream, which passes identically under [stderr, stdout] and [stdout, stderr]. Because truncatePreflightDetail (src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts:135-140) renders the FIRST LINE ONLY and collapses the rest to '(+N more)', reversing the order silently reintroduces the exact operator-facing bug this story fixes while the suite stays green. Reviewer-executed proof: stderr-first yields 'error TS2345: Argument type is not assignable (+1 more)'; stdout-first yields 'tsc version 5.x banner chatter (+1 more)'. Both satisfy every current assertion. Fix is mechanical and single-file: assert on the first line, e.g. expect(result.detail.split('\n')[0]).toContain('TS2345'), or assert truncatePreflightDetail(result.detail) contains the verdict.

userStories.title: Capture stderr in plan-preflight failure detail
userStories.description: As an operator whose loop was halted by a plan-preflight gate, I need the failure marker's detail to carry the stderr output of the failing step so that I can actually diagnose why the gate fired, instead of reading 42KB of incidental stdout chatter with no verdict in it.
acceptanceCriteria: PlanPreflightSpawnFn's return type declares `stderr: string` as a REQUIRED (non-optional) property. [oracle: file-assert grep -qE 'stderr: string' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts && ! grep -qE 'stderr\?: string' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]

The production preflightSpawnFn in src/commands/sidecar.ts decodes r.stderr and returns it, using the same Buffer/TextDecoder guard already applied to stdout on the adjacent line. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'r.stderr instanceof Buffer' src/commands/sidecar.ts]

For a failing typecheck step, PlanPreflightResult.detail contains text that was written to stderr only, proved by a unit test whose fake spawn returns empty stdout and non-empty stderr. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

For a failing bun-test step, PlanPreflightResult.detail contains text written to stderr only, proved by a unit test whose fake spawn returns empty stdout and a bun-style summary line on stderr. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

For a failing git-checkout-main step and a failing git-pull step, detail likewise includes stderr content, proved by unit tests of the same shape. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]
When a failing step writes to BOTH stdout and stderr, detail contains content from both streams, proved by a unit test. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]
The combination order places the stderr verdict where it survives truncatePreflightDetail's first-line rendering, and an inline comment states that reasoning. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The clean-tree step's detail remains stdout-only and its existing test at test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:150 still passes unchanged. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -n 'stderr' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts | grep -q "step: 'clean-tree'"]

The existing bun-test stdout test (plan-preflight.test.ts:208, stdout '1 fail / 0 pass' asserting detail contains 'fail') still passes; the stderr tests are additions, not replacements. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

The writer-params key set assertion at test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts:421 (`['detail','step']`) passes unmodified, proving no new marker field was introduced. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]
test/templates/orchestrator-boot.test.ts passes unmodified, proving the boot contract was not touched. [oracle: bun test test/templates/orchestrator-boot.test.ts]

The doc comment at src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts:22 no longer claims the spawn fn returns 'combined stdout'; it accurately describes stdout, stderr and exitCode. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'combined stdout' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]
src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts is byte-identical to main. [oracle: file-assert git diff --quiet main -- src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts]
src/commands/sidecar.ts loopSpawnFn (around :2629-2635) is unchanged; it has the identical stderr drop but is deliberately out of scope. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes:
THREE coordinated edits, nothing more. (1) src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts:31 - add REQUIRED `stderr: string` to PlanPreflightSpawnFn's return type. (2) src/commands/sidecar.ts:2639-2645 - the production preflightSpawnFn ALREADY passes `stderr: 'pipe'` to Bun.spawnSync; r.stderr is a populated Buffer that the closure simply never decodes. Do NOT rewrite the spawn call or change its options; only decode and return the already-captured value, mirroring the adjacent stdout guard. (3) src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts - put a COMBINED stdout+stderr string into `detail` at the four failing-step return sites: :77 git-checkout-main, :83 git-pull, :102 typecheck, :108 bun-test. Do NOT change :96 clean-tree, which legitimately reports git porcelain stdout and has no stderr verdict.

ORDERING IS THE CRUX. readPlanPreflightFailedMarker has ZERO production callers: the real consumer of `detail` is a human-facing blocker line rendered through truncatePreflightDetail as first-line + ' (+N more)'. If stdout is incidental chatter (42KB of cam banners, the reported failure) and stderr holds the verdict, a naive stdout-then-stderr concatenation buries the verdict and the operator-facing first line stays useless. Choose the order so diagnostic value survives truncation to one line, and state the reasoning in a comment.

Concatenation, not a preference chain: a bun-test failure can legitimately write to BOTH streams, so preferring one would drop the other; a preference chain is only right when one stream is expected empty. Follow the repo's existing inline convention, do NOT add a shared helper for four call sites. Closest precedents: src/release/ship-pr.ts:268 (preference-with-fallback) and src/commands/sidecar.ts:1102-1107 (concatenate).

EXPECTED BREAKAGE: making stderr REQUIRED will break typecheck in test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts until the fake-spawn fixture arrays at :41 (makeFakeSpawn responses type) and :56 (allPassResponses) supply stderr on every entry. That breakage is the point: update the fixtures, do NOT weaken the type to optional. This repo has twice shipped bugs from fixtures encoding a wrong process model.

DO NOT: add any field to the marker (PlanPreflightFailedMarker stays exactly { step, detail, writtenAt }); touch src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts; touch truncatePreflightDetail; touch orchestrator boot-contract templates or .claude/agents copies; change loopSpawnFn at sidecar.ts:2629-2635 (identical drop, separate code path, separate issue). The marker READER at plan-preflight-marker.ts:72-94 is whitelist-style and tolerates extra fields, so it would NOT catch an accidental new field: rely on the postaudit key-set test as the guard, and never 'fix' that test.

Do NOT attempt to diagnose or fix the underlying one-off bun-test red that motivated this issue. This change is the PREREQUISITE for diagnosing it if it recurs; claiming otherwise is an overclaim.

Gates: bun run typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all. No vendor/templates change is expected, so embed-vendor should NOT be needed; if you find yourself needing it, you have touched a template and gone out of scope. Bun docs confirm SyncSubprocess.stderr is `Buffer | undefined` (see officialDocsConsulted).

findings.text: AC7's stderr-first ordering invariant has no regression assertion. The two 'BOTH streams' tests (:249-250 typecheck, :303-304 bun-test) assert only detail.toContain(...) for each stream, which passes identically under [stderr, stdout] and [stdout, stderr]. Because truncatePreflightDetail (src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts:135-140) renders the FIRST LINE ONLY and collapses the rest to '(+N more)', reversing the order silently reintroduces the exact operator-facing bug this story fixes while the suite stays green. Reviewer-executed proof: stderr-first yields 'error TS2345: Argument type is not assignable (+1 more)'; stdout-first yields 'tsc version 5.x banner chatter (+1 more)'. Both satisfy every current assertion. Fix is mechanical and single-file: assert on the first line, e.g. expect(result.detail.split('\n')[0]).toContain('TS2345'), or assert truncatePreflightDetail(result.detail) contains the verdict.

The expression [a.stderr, a.stdout].filter((s) => s.trim().length > 0).join('\n').trim() is repeated verbatim at :86, :94, :117 and :128. A small local helper (e.g. combineStreams(res)) would remove the four-way duplication and give the stderr-first ordering a single point of definition, which would also make the invariant easier to test directly.

AC8's oracle form (`! grep -n 'stderr' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts | grep -q "step: 'clean-tree'"`) is near-tautological: the piped grep can essentially never match, so the assertion passes regardless of the code. It was verified by reading the source instead (clean-tree at plan-preflight.ts:106-109 is genuinely stdout-only). Future PRDs should avoid oracle shapes that cannot fail.
